features.notes: docs/plans/native-core.md build step 6. BLOCKED: voice edit needs the user's MiniMax key (and a Groq key). MiniMaxRewriter is covered by MockWebServer tests; not exercised live. Hardening done 2026-09-24 without a key: an edit is now refused before the mic opens, with a distinct reason — No text field / Can't edit a password field / Nothing to edit / Too much text to edit. FieldTarget carries `secure` from node.isPassword, so a password field's text never reaches MiniMax, and TextSplicer.MAX_EDIT_CHARS caps a whole-field rewrite at 8000 characters, matching the Mac app's edit-target.ts. Still BLOCKED on a live MiniMax key for the on-device rewrite and undo. The gesture was replaced on 2026-09-24: double-tap-then-hold is gone, and one hold now slides through three detents toward the centre of the screen — rest dictates, ~40 dp edits, ~96 dp cancels — snapping to each with a haptic, and the mode is decided on release. Refusals moved again: the edit detent simply does not exist when the field cannot be rewritten, and the capsule says why at rest. NOT verified on a device: adb-injected touches do not register as a hold on the accessibility overlay, so the slide, the snap and the colour change have never been seen running.

features.title: Nunito type and animated empty states
features.user_visible_behavior: Interface text is set in Nunito Sans and titles and figures in rounded Nunito, replacing Geist, Geist Mono and Instrument Serif. Empty states show a looping drawn scene and one short line: History first run (orb dictating into a field, action Try it opens a practice sheet), History while Parley cannot run (dozing orb, action Turn on fixes the first blocker), History search with no match (magnifier over ghost rows, action Clear), and Overview before the first dictation (a ring around the orb lighting one segment per setup step, replacing the zero figures). A transcript that no longer exists returns to History with a snack bar instead of a dead-end screen.
